(BBOX, WIDTH, HEIGHT, CRS, LAYERS, STYLES, FORMAT, TIME/ELEVATION/DIM_*)

requested dims, fixvalue, then defaults for omitted dims
rows (path, dimval, dimindex, ...) → addStep(path) + CDFDims per step

setPixel(x, y, color), drawContour(), lines/text via Cairo
